ns2:section.sectionText: This course will cover soil and water samples protocol, methods and techniques recommended by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) and Natural Resource Conservation Services (NRCS). Due to difficulties in accessing subsurface samples, sampling activities focus on surface water samples and top soils. We will visit field sites around the UIUC campus and receive detailed instructions and descriptions of the soil and water sampling methods. Each lecture and field trip will last 1.4 hrs and 2 hrs, respectively. There is no course fee associated with this section of NRES 285.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Natural Resrcs & Environ Sci major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
